input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

doc_friction.issue: Item 4 frames visitor wait as page weight; for single-tool pages whose first action needs every module (sales-export-to-journal detect runs all 17 engines), compute time on a realistic large input is the lever and module-weight.mjs points the wrong way.
Takes no file argument (only --root); the post front-matter rule (description 60-160) surfaced only via run_workflow_locally.

deviations.why: 'Same answers, faster' — the detection scoring change alters answers on files over ~40 rows; it is a correctness fix found while timing, not a speed-up.
deviations.did: Shipped it in the same PR with a test that is red on the old code (7/17) and green on the new; engine output changes are separately pinned byte-identical (681,513 comparisons).
deviations.result: 17/17 platforms detect correctly at 5,000 rows; small-file rankings unchanged.

notes: Metric: sales-export-to-journal convert() median of 5 on each platform's sample grown to 5,000 lines (Node 22, container). Before: sum 3,311-3,432 ms, PayPal 1,111 ms, Shopify 452-466 ms; 10/17 detected correctly. After: sum 2,188-2,261 ms, PayPal 288 ms, Shopify 274 ms; 17/17. Profile (node --cpu-prof): 1.55 s of 1.6 s in money() (toLocaleString with options builds an Intl.NumberFormat per call) plus 797 ms in a per-platform full-file split in signatureBoost. Verification: old vs new engines 681,513 comparisons, 0 diffs; run_venture_tests.py on 14 touched ventures: 14 suites 0 failed. Next lever: same toLocaleString pattern in 314 .mjs files repo-wide.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: profile, scoring-bug diagnosis, 30-file mechanical change with equivalence harness, tests and write-ups

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
